title: Connect durable collection jobs to existing ingestion ports
objective: Implement the exact adopted v3 bounded fixture collection job, durable local recovery and actual research capture contracts.
outcome: Bounded collection jobs resume safely and have durable outcomes.

commits.subject: Add a collection job specification
commits.instructions: Reuse ingestion run/outbox/lease primitives and add source ID, exact configuration hash, selected record IDs, capture class and budget reservation. Keep scheduling separate from execution. Adopt the exact v3 resolver and separate child-job identity contracts in verification/research-program/bootstrap/pr010-interface-adoption-20260912/proposal-v3/proposal.json (SHA256 0a6184f9da889e019439562c2de94850bf97ca85e7b8b3c85e0ab2b49a126409). Verify approved source/revision/route and ushso-canonical-json.v1 descriptor digest before admission or effects; reuse existing scheduler identity unchanged, with one connector repository per child. The ten named implementation/test paths replace the former broad directories; task evidence and handoff remain owned.
commits.verification: Duplicate schedule deliveries create one logical job; changing configuration produces a distinct job identity.

commits.subject: Implement the collector port adapter
commits.instructions: Connect existing research collector entry points through injected storage/network/clock ports. Checkpoint after bounded units and close database work between steps. Adopt the same v3 actual refresh.capture integration, durable whole-transaction journal and strict result/Map/byte codec; keep shared poison, child/parent recovery, durable intent/reservation/response ordering, unknown-intent partial_unresolved, cancellation/deadline fences and fresh-process replay. Add only the capture clock and paired locatorPolicy/explicit own callable fetchImpl seam, defaulting to unchanged metadataUrl. Use exactly source_fixture_catalog, catalog.example.gov and /data.json with its bounded cursor; preserve actual 304 null-body handling. Keep observation/recorded/governor clocks separate and in-memory governor state explicitly non-durable.
commits.verification: Interrupt after a successful capture and resume without duplicate source requests or losing the capture reference.

commits.subject: Expose dry-run and local execution commands
commits.instructions: Add a CLI that lists selected jobs and estimated limits before running. Emit terminal statuses and resumable checkpoint locations. Adopt the exact fixed-fixture preview/run/resume/status CLI and package-local job:preview/job:fixture scripts from the v3 proposal. Preview performs no file writes; mutating fixture execution requires the OS-held lock. Preserve frozen connectors/WP5, ingestion contracts, SQL/grants, root package/lockfile, all service compositions and disabled live/managed/paid/production boundaries. Retain all 36 planned implementation test groups; the earlier 15/15 compatibility probe is not implementation acceptance.
commits.verification: An intern can run a fixture job through selected, running, partial and complete states; production composition stays disabled.
